jcr:title: Stryker Sponsors the PGA TOUR's 2021 World Golf Championships-FedEx St. Jude Invitational and Educates Fans on Joint Health

text.text:
MEMPHIS, Tenn.—July 30, 2021—Stryker, one of the world’s leading medical technology companies, announced today that it will be a top 20 sponsor of the PGA 2021 World Golf Championship-FedEx St. Jude Invitational. The PGA TOUR event will be held Aug. 2-8, 2021, at TPC Southwind in Memphis, Tenn.

Along the 18th fairway, Stryker will host an engagement exhibit in The Hub, where ticket holders can discover the treatment options that Stryker offers for joint pain. Visitors are welcome to engage in various interactive stations at the Stryker booth while taking a break from the heat in the air-conditioned space. Team members will also be there to answer any questions about Stryker’s foot, ankle and shoulder products.

“We’re excited to welcome Stryker and their Memphis-based foot and ankle business to the WGC-FedEx St. Jude Invitational,” said Erin Stone, WGC-FedEx St. Jude Invitational tournament director. “Fans can stop by The Hub onsite at the tournament to learn more about joint health from the Stryker team through this interactive exhibit.”

About the World Golf Championships-FedEx St. Jude Invitational
The City of Memphis has held a PGA TOUR event every year since 1958, and 2021 will mark Memphis’s third year hosting a World Golf Championships event. The WGC event annually brings the best players in the world to Memphis for one of the strongest fields of the year. The 2021 tournament will be played August 2-8. Since 1970, Memphis’s PGA TOUR stop has raised more than $50 million for the tournament’s primary charitable beneficiary, St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, helping to ensure patients’ families never receive a bill and can focus solely on helping their child.

Visit WGCFedEx.com for more information.

About Stryker
Stryker is one of the world’s leading medical technology companies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in Orthopaedics, Medical and Surgical and Neurotechnology and Spine that help improve patient and hospital outcomes. More information is available at www.stryker.com.
